subject: Procedure division structure
notes: §14.2.3 GR5 'Data-name-1 is a formal parameter for the function, method, or program.' Definitional: every USING data-name-1 becomes a LinkageFormal (program/function) or OoFormal (method) at its position; probes gr2_pos / gr2_oo / gr6_func show each is bound to its argument. The defective EDGES of which data-name-1 are admissible belong to SR-14.2.2-1.
